svg.text: Unlabelled arrows fire on timer_done. Hold self-loops are omitted.
S_AR_EW2NS exits also wait for timer_done. Priority: emergency, then ped_grant & ped_pending, then IS_MASTER (else WAIT_SYNC).
On emergency a green phase ends early (to yellow); yellow enters S_EMERGENCY on timer_done if emergency is active or latched (pending).
